## AlertDialog.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `open` :: Whether the confirmation dialog is open. Bind it, or let the `trigger` drive it.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called whenever the dialog opens or closes.
- `title` :: The heading. Wired as the accessible name.
- `description` :: A line under the heading. Wired as the accessible description.
- `tone` :: The colour of the confirm action.
- `confirmLabel` :: The label of the confirm action.
- `cancelLabel` :: The label of the cancel action — the least destructive choice, and where focus lands.
- `confirmButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the confirm Button, so a caller can change its size, shape or ink on top of the tone.
- `cancelButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the cancel Button, so a caller can give the quiet action a different look.
- `onConfirm` :: Called when the confirm action is pressed. If it returns a promise, the action stays in a loading state until it settles; returning `false` keeps the dialog open.
- `onCancel` :: Called when the cancel action is pressed.
- `trigger` :: Renders the element that opens the dialog. Spread `props` onto your own button.
- `children` :: Optional body between the description and the actions. Receives `close`.

## Confirmer.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `class` :: Reserved for the host element; the confirmer itself has no visual props of its own.

## confirm.ts

### `interface ConfirmOptions`

Options accepted by the imperative `confirm()` helper.

- `title` :: The heading of the confirmation dialog.
- `description` :: A line under the heading that explains the choice.
- `tone` :: The colour of the confirm action.
- `confirmLabel` :: The label of the confirm action.
- `cancelLabel` :: The label of the cancel action.

### `function confirm`

Ask the user to confirm a choice. Requires a `<Confirmer />` somewhere in the tree.

### `function subscribeConfirmer`

Used by `<Confirmer />` to observe the pending request. Not a public API.

### `function settleConfirm`

Resolve the current request and show the next one, if any.
